classification_reasons.runtime-callsite-formatting: Callsite function-name formatting; not consumed by the selected wire or its fixed error codes.
classification_reasons.runtime-dns: c-ares resolver changes affect Node-originated DNS. The sidecar itself uses local stdio; no provider or network proof is claimed.
classification_reasons.runtime-global-http-client: Undici and its bundled global HTTP client change. The sidecar does not use global fetch or Undici; provider-facing HTTP remains under its existing exact-point live gate.
classification_reasons.runtime-http2: Node HTTP/2 memory-safety fix. The sidecar does not call Node HTTP/2; no live-network conclusion is inferred.
classification_reasons.runtime-js-engine: V8 engine patch; the candidate executable is identified and runs the fake-backed sidecar tests without changing their selected projections.
classification_reasons.runtime-locale-time-data: ICU/time-zone data updates; not consumed by the selected wire or lifecycle mapping.
classification_reasons.runtime-node-api: Additive Node-API SharedArrayBuffer functions; this sidecar and the SDK wrapper route use JavaScript plus a spawned native Claude CLI, not Node native addons.
classification_reasons.runtime-tls-trust-store: Root certificate, OpenSSL and TLS changes affect Node-originated secure networking. The selected sidecar transport is local stdio and it does not initiate provider HTTP; live provider and HTTP-MCP evidence is not transferred.
classification_reasons.runtime-url-setter: URL setter behavior for unparseable serialized URLs; no URL setter is used by the selected sidecar protocol.
classification_reasons.runtime-version-metadata: Upstream Node version metadata supporting the exact runtime identity.
classification_reasons.runtime-windows-task-runner: Windows task-runner environment escaping; the tested supported runtime archive is Darwin arm64 and the adapter launches its declared entry point directly.
classification_reasons.selected-esm-loader-fs-patchability: The sidecar entry point and imported SDK are ES modules. Node changes ESM internals from destructured fs functions to the fs module object, restoring explicit fs patchability. The sidecar does not patch fs; exact Node 22.23.3 fake-sidecar execution checks loading and open with a fake SDK.
classification_reasons.unselected-corepack: Bundled Corepack package files; the approved launch recipe does not invoke Corepack.
classification_reasons.unselected-npm: Bundled npm package files; the approved launch recipe invokes Node with the sidecar entry point, not npm.
classification_reasons.unshipped-ci-or-test: Upstream workflow/test files are not part of the Node distribution and do not execute in the selected route.
classification_reasons.unshipped-docs-or-build-tooling: Upstream documentation/build/release tooling is discovery context, not an application runtime dependency.
